detail.longDescription: This thought popped in my head today. Most of us probably know the fundamentals of programming by now - data structures, complexity (big O), type systems, functions, architecture etc. But what are the fundamentals of this new era of coding? Have any had time to develop as it's changing so fast? 2 years ago prompt engineering was something people took seriously, but now the harnesses take care of it and you can again just prompt "its wrong please fix". Maybe setting up feedback loops can be a fundamental? It seems to be the current fad at least. Curious to hear your experiences.
